dct_title_s: Arctic Ocean, Greenland Sea, Jan Mayen (Norway) (Raster Image)
dct_description_sm: prepared andpublished by the Defense Mapping Agency. Depths shown by isolines and soundings. Relief shown by contours and spot heights. "From Norwegian surveys between 1951 and 1954." Place names in romanized Norwegian with glossary in English. "Copyright 1996 by the United States Government. No copyright claimed under Title 17 U.S.C." Soundings in fathoms and feet. Map No. 38181.
This map is part of a collection of scanned and georeferenced nautical charts produced by the National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency (NGA).
